narrative: Bound by sacred oaths and fueled by Stormlight, the Knights Radiant fight with Surgebinding, Shardblades and unbreakable resolve.
teamComposition:
Select exactly:
- 1 Bondsmith Leader: Stormfather, Nightwatcher or Sibling.
- 5 Knight Radiant operatives: Select five different Orders from the nine available.

abilities.name: Voice of the Highstorm
abilities.timing: At the start of each Turning Point after the first
abilities.rulesText: After resolving the Stormlight Pool rule, gain 1 additional Stormlight, up to the pool maximum of 5.

uniqueActions.name: The Storm Unites
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select up to two friendly Knight Radiant operatives visible to and within 6" of this operative. Each selected operative can immediately perform a free Dash action, following the normal rules.

abilities.name: A Boon and a Curse
abilities.timing: At the end of the activation of an enemy operative that targeted this operative
abilities.rulesText:
Until the end of the Battle, improve 1 of the enemy operative characteristics and worsen another 2. The player controlling the enemy operative chooses which characteristic to improve and then the player controlling this operative chooses which characteristics to worsen.
APL is improved by increasing it by 1 and worsened by decreasing it by 1. Movement is improved by increasing it by 1" and worsened by decreasing it by 1". Save is improved by decreasing it by 1 and worsened by increasing it by 1. Wounds is improved by increasing its current and maximum values by 2 and worsened by decreasing them by 2.

abilities.name: Lifelight
abilities.timing: After a friendly Knight Radiant within 6" of this operative spends Stormlight
abilities.rulesText: Select a friendly Knight Radiant visible to and within 6" of this operative. Restore up to 2 lost Wounds to that operative, up to its starting Wounds characteristic.

uniqueActions.name: Old Magic
uniqueActions.restrictions: Once per Turning Point per operative
uniqueActions.rulesText:
Choose one of the following:
- Blessing: Select a friendly Knight Radiant visible to and within 6" of this operative. The next time that operative performs a Shoot or Fight action this Turning Point, it can re-roll one attack die during that action.
- Burden: Select an enemy operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the end of that enemy operative's next activation, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic, to a minimum of 3", and it cannot perform Dash actions.

abilities.name: Towerlight Resonance
abilities.timing: When a friendly Knight Radiant within 6" of this operative is selected as the target of a Shoot action
abilities.rulesText: After the attacker rolls its attack dice but before any dice are retained, the attacker must re-roll one attack die of your choice.

uniqueActions.name: Towerlight Ward
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select a friendly Knight Radiant visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the end of the Turning Point, reduce the damage of each attack against the friendly operative by 1, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Adhesion: Anchored Bond
abilities.timing: When an enemy rule would move this operative or a friendly Knight Radiant within 3" of this operative
abilities.rulesText: Reduce the distance that operative is moved by 2", to a minimum of 0".

uniqueActions.name: Gravitation: Basic Lashing
uniqueActions.rulesText: Perform a Reposition action with the following modifications: increase the maximum distance moved by 2", ignore vertical distance when measuring the move, and allow this operative to move through enemy operatives' control ranges. It must end outside all enemy control ranges and cannot move through operative bases or solid terrain.

uniqueActions.name: Adhesion: Full Lashing
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select one point on the killzone floor or on a non-living terrain feature visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the start of this operative's next activation, enemy operatives cannot move through that point, and an operative that starts a move within 1" of it cannot move more than 3" during that action.

uniqueActions.name: Adhesion and Gravitation: Reverse Lashing
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select a point visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the start of this operative's next activation, enemy operatives within 2" of that point cannot retain critical successes during Shoot actions unless they are within 6" of their target.

abilities.name: Abrasion: Slick Movement
abilities.rulesText: This operative can move through enemy control ranges during that action, but must end outside all enemy control ranges. It cannot move through operative bases or solid terrain.

uniqueActions.name: Progression: Regrowth
uniqueActions.restrictions: Once per Turning Point, Once per Battle per Operative
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select a friendly Knight Radiant visible to and within 2" of this operative, and not within an enemy operative's control range. Restore up to 3 lost Wounds to the selected operative, up to its starting Wounds characteristic.

abilities.name: Gravitation: Skyward Pursuit
abilities.rulesText: Ignore up to 2" of vertical distance when measuring the distance this operative must move.

uniqueActions.name: Division: Skybreak Sentence
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select one enemy operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the end of the Turning Point, friendly Knights Radiant can retain one attack die as a critical success when making a Fight action against that enemy operative. If that enemy operative is incapacitated during the Turning Point, gain 1 Command point. This effect can grant a Command point only once per battle.

equipmentOptions.name: Shardplate
equipmentOptions.rulesText: When this operative is the target of a Shoot or Fight action, the first time it would suffer damage during that action, reduce that damage by 1, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Oath: Free the Captive
abilities.timing: When determining control of an objective marker
abilities.rulesText: Treat this operative's APL as 4 instead of 3 if its base is touching an objective marker.

uniqueActions.name: Cohesion: Shape Stone
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select one point on or within 2" of a non-living Heavy terrain feature visible to this operative. Until the end of the Turning Point, friendly Knights Radiant within 1" of the selected point are in Cover.

uniqueActions.name: Transportation: Freedom Step
uniqueActions.rulesText: Remove this operative from the killzone and set it up again in a legal position within 3" horizontally of its original position, ignoring vertical distance and intervening terrain. It cannot be set up within an enemy operative's control range or inside solid terrain.

abilities.name: Transportation: Elsecalling
abilities.rulesText: This operative can ignore vertical distance when measuring that action. It cannot move through solid terrain or operative bases and must finish in a legal position.

uniqueActions.name: Transformation: Soulcast Cover
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select a point visible to this operative and within 6". Until the end of the Turning Point, treat that point as providing Cover for friendly Knights Radiant within 2" of it. This does not create terrain or block movement.

weapons.name: Illumination: Sunburst Flare
weapons.rulesText: Range 6", Blast 1", Lethal 5+, Piercing Crits 1, Silent, Stun, Stormlight 1

uniqueActions.name: Illumination: False Target
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select a point visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the end of the Turning Point, the when an enemy operative within 3" of that point performs a Shoot action, subtract 1 from its Attacks characteristic, to a minimum of 1.

uniqueActions.name: Illumination and Transformation: Living Disguise
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select this operative or a friendly Knight Radiant visible to and within 6" of it. Until the start of the selected operative's next activation, it cannot be selected as a valid target for a Shoot action made by an enemy operative more than 6" away. If the selected operative performs a Fight action, this rule ends after that action.

abilities.name: Progression: Minor Regrowth
abilities.timing: At the end of this operative's activation
abilities.rulesText: Select a friendly wounded Knight Radiant visible to and within 2" of this operative. Restore 1 lost Wound to that operative, up to its starting Wounds characteristic.

uniqueActions.name: Illumination: Possible Future
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select one enemy operative visible to and within 8" of this operative. Until the end of the Turning Point, the cost of the next mission action performed by that enemy operative is increased by 1 AP.

abilities.name: Abrasion: Relentless Charge
abilities.rulesText: The Shardblade and Dagger gains the Relentless weapon rule for the subsequent Fight action.

uniqueActions.name: Division: Precise Ignition
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select one enemy operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. That operative suffers 2 damage. If it is within 1" of a non-living terrain feature, you can instead select that terrain feature; until the end of the Turning Point, it does not provide Cover.

equipmentOptions.name: Shardplate
equipmentOptions.rulesText: When this operative is the target of a Shoot or Fight action, the first time it would suffer damage during that action, reduce that damage by 1, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Cohesion: Immovable Foundation
abilities.timing: Whenever an enemy rule would move this operative
abilities.rulesText: This operative cannot be moved by enemy abilities or rules unless that rule explicitly states that the target cannot resist being moved.

uniqueActions.name: Cohesion and Tension: Harden the Ground
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select an objective marker within 2" of this operative. Until the start of this operative's next activation, while this operative contests that marker, subtract 1 from the APL of each enemy operative contesting it when determining control, to a minimum of 1.

uniqueActions.name: Tension: Stoneward's Stand
uniqueActions.rulesText: Until the start of this operative's next activation, when this operative is the target of a Shoot or Fight action, the first time it would suffer damage during that action, reduce that damage by 1, to a minimum of 0.

equipmentOptions.name: Shardplate
equipmentOptions.rulesText: When this operative is the target of a Shoot or Fight action, the first time it would suffer damage during that action, reduce that damage by 1, to a minimum of 0.

rules.name: Stormlight Pool
rules.rulesText: At the start of the battle, gain 3 Stormlight. At the start of each subsequent Turning Point, gain 2 Stormlight, up to a maximum of 5. Stormlight is shared by the entire Kill Team and tracked using tokens or dice.

rules.name: Stormlight X
rules.rulesText: Before selecting a weapon with the Stormlight X rule for a Shoot action, spend X Stormlight. If you cannot pay this cost, you cannot select that weapon profile.

strategyPloys.name: Journey Before Destination
strategyPloys.timing: At the start of the Turning Point
strategyPloys.rulesText: Select up to two friendly Knights Radiant. The first time each selected operative performs a Reposition or Charge action during that Turning Point, add 1" to its maximum movement distance.

strategyPloys.name: Oaths of the Order
strategyPloys.timing: At the start of the Turning Point
strategyPloys.rulesText: Select up to two friendly Knights Radiant. The first time each selected operative uses Stormlight during that Turning Point it uses 1 less Stormlight, to a minimum of 0.

strategyPloys.name: Wind and Words
strategyPloys.timing: At the start of the Turning Point
strategyPloys.rulesText: Select up to two friendly Knights Radiant. The first time each selected operative performs a Fight action during this Turning Point, it can perform a free Dash action after that Fight action, following the normal rules.

strategyPloys.name: Oathbound Formation
strategyPloys.timing: At the start of the Turning Point
strategyPloys.rulesText: Select up to three friendly Knights Radiant. Until the end of the Turning Point, each selected operative can retain one success die as a critical success during a Fight action if another selected operative is within 3" of it.

firefightPloys.name: Life Before Death
firefightPloys.timing: When a friendly Knight Radiant would be incapacitated
firefightPloys.rulesText: Instead of being incapacitated, that operative remains in the killzone with 1 Wound remaining. Ignore any further damage inflicted on that operative for the remainder of the current Shoot or Fight action.

firefightPloys.name: Strength Before Weakness
firefightPloys.timing: Before a friendly Knight Radiant performs a Fight action
firefightPloys.rulesText: That operative can re-roll up to two of its attack dice during that Fight action.
